title: Swap two variables
prompt: Swap the values of a and b using a third variable called `temp`. After the swap, return a (it should now hold what b had).
signature: func solve(a: int, b: int) -> int:
starter:
func solve(a: int, b: int) -> int:
	return a
hint: Three steps: put a into temp, put b into a, put temp into b.
solution:
func solve(a: int, b: int) -> int:
	var temp = a
	a = b
	b = temp
	return a
